68	## 2. The carrier decision (task pin 1)
69	
70	### 2.1 What the consumers actually force
71	
72	Tracing every pinned consumer (wave3 §6.1–6.2, route item 7, Wave-4 N2):
73	
74	1. (E-i): a *number* attached to an effective `LocalEquations` datum, equal to
75	   `dim_K Γ(𝒪_D)` (pushforward-rank / B4 shape).
76	2. (E-ii): `deg` on `CechPic ((C_K).left)` classes, additive.
77	3. (E-iii): a χ attached to divisor data, satisfying `χ = χ(𝒪) + deg`.
78	4. (E-iv): invariance of 2 under `K → K'`.
79	5. Riemann inequality: `h⁰(𝒪(D)) ≥ deg D + 1 − g` (Wave-4 N2 growth).
80	6. `χ(𝒪) = 1 − g`, finiteness of all `h⁰/h¹` involved.
81	
82	No consumer needs: χ of an arbitrary Pic class *presented as a cocycle* (the meromorphic
83	bridge always supplies a divisor presentation first); tensor products of sheaves; pullback
84	functoriality of `𝒪(D)` along morphisms other than field-extension projections; Serre duality;
85	uniform `h¹`-vanishing (Wave-4-owned, route item 12).

98	### 2.3 The adopted shape, and the two corrections to the notes
99	
100	Adopted from chi-ledger-notes "recommended shape": `𝒪(D)` as subsheaf of the constant
101	function-field sheaf; skyscraper quotients; χ additivity by the Ext LES; finiteness by
102	dévissage from the landed `Module.Finite k H¹(C,𝒪)`; (E-iv) via `SectionsBaseChange` + flat
103	`⊗_K K'`. **Audit outcome: recommendation CONFIRMED**, with two corrections:
104	
105	1. **The notes underspecified the one new cohomological brick.** Skyscraper dévissage via the
106	   LES needs `H¹(X, sky) = 0`, which is *not* free from "the LES is available": it needs an
107	   acyclicity input. Computing it through the two-cover would re-import the twisted-affine-
108	   vanishing problem the notes set out to avoid (a skyscraper is not `𝒪` on the charts). The
109	   honest route (§4.3): skyscraper of an injective `K`-module is an injective *sheaf*
110	   (adjunction `stalk ⊣ skyscraper` — mathlib `stalkSkyscraperSheafAdjunction`,
111	   `Topology/Sheaves/Skyscraper.lean:400`, left adjoint preserves monos —
112	   `Topology/Sheaves/Stalks.lean:544`, `Injective.injective_of_adjoint` —
113	   `CategoryTheory/Preadditive/Injective/Basic.lean:195`), then one application of the landed
114	   criterion `Abelian.Ext.subsingleton_one_of_injective_of_surjective`
115	   (`AffineVanishing.lean:61`) with `I := sky(I⁰)`. Whole-site, no affine hypothesis anywhere.
116	2. **The notes' route for "principal divisors have degree 0" is overturned.** The notes
117	   proposed "order-sum of a rational function vanishes — Weil repartition / two-chart argument
118	   over ℙ¹ via the landed finite π". Both variants are strictly heavier than needed and the
119	   order-sum statement is exactly where non-perfect/non-closed subtleties concentrate
120	   (norms/inseparability, residue-weighting). Instead (§5.4): multiplication by `f` is a
121	   `K`-linear sheaf isomorphism `𝒪(D) ≅ 𝒪(D − div f)`; χ is iso-invariant; with (E-iii) for
122	   *arbitrary* divisors, `deg(div f) = χ(𝒪(div f)) − χ(𝒪) = 0`. Truth-audit §11: valid over
123	   any field, any (in)separability. The classical order-sum theorem is *recovered* as a
124	   corollary, never used as an input.

130	### 3.1 Closed points (file R2)
131	
132	```lean
133	-- On the curve bundle, "closed point" ⟺ "≠ generic point" (landed:
134	-- Scheme.isClosed_singleton_of_forall_specializes + specializes_eq_genericPoint_or_eq).
135	-- Deliverables at a closed point x:
136	theorem isDiscreteValuationRing_stalk (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X) :
137	    IsDiscreteValuationRing (X.presheaf.stalk x)
138	  -- re-run of the landed IsAffineOpen.valuationRing_stalk case split (StalksDVR.lean:50–70):
139	  -- x ≠ generic ⇒ the chart prime is ≠ ⊥ ⇒ the DVR branch; plus IsDedekindDomain via
140	  -- IsPrincipalIdealRing.isDedekindDomain (Mathlib RingTheory/DedekindDomain/Basic.lean:171)
141	def stalkHeightOne (hx) : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (X.presheaf.stalk x)
142	  -- the maximal ideal; ne_bot from ¬IsField
143	noncomputable def ord (hx) : Valuation X.functionField ℤᵐ⁰ := (stalkHeightOne hx).valuation _
144	  -- via the mathlib instance IsFractionRing (stalk x) X.functionField
145	  -- (AlgebraicGeometry/FunctionField.lean:157, needs IsIntegral X — Wave-1 instance)
146	noncomputable def ordUnits (hx) : X.functionFieldˣ →* Multiplicative ℤ   -- ℤ-valued order hom
147	noncomputable def residueDeg (K) (x) : ℕ := Module.finrank K (X.residueField x)
148	theorem residueDeg_pos / residueDeg_finite :
149	    0 < residueDeg K x ∧ Module.Finite K (X.residueField x)   -- for x closed
150	```
151	
152	`residueDeg_finite` is Zariski's lemma on the Dedekind chart: `κ(x)` is a field, finite-type
153	over `K` (chart ring is), hence module-finite — mathlib
154	`finite_of_finite_type_of_isJacobsonRing` (`RingTheory/Jacobson/Ring.lean:675`, fields are
155	Jacobson). The `K`-module structures on `κ(x)` and on the stalk are carried by explicit
156	`algebraMap` composites through `X ↘ Spec (.of K)` in the style of `Scheme.overAlgebraMap`
157	(`ModuleKSheaf.lean:192`) — never a global `Algebra` instance (same overlap hazard).
158	
159	**Vocabulary decision (OPEN-2 default).** The stalkwise `HeightOneSpectrum`-valuation is the
160	pinned order vocabulary: it is chart-free (no chart-independence lemma needed), `g = 0` is
161	handled by the valuation's bottom automatically, and the FLT-style `ℤᵐ⁰` API
162	(`intValuation`/`valuation`, `DedekindDomain/AdicValuation.lean:169,327`) is the most complete
163	order toolbox in v4.31 (no `HeightOneSpectrum.ord` exists there — grep-verified). Fractional-
164	ideal membership and `IsDiscreteValuationRing`-multiplicity phrasings are fallbacks.

166	### 3.2 The divisor group and `deg` (file R3)
167	
168	```lean
169	/-- Weil divisors on the curve: finitely supported ℤ-valued functions on closed points. -/
170	def Scheme.CurveDivisor (X : Scheme.{u}) : Type u := {x : X // x ≠ genericPoint X} →₀ ℤ
171	-- AddCommGroup, pointwise partial order, `Effective D := 0 ≤ D`, single-point divisors —
172	-- all free from Finsupp. (OPEN-3: subtype-index vs full-index-with-support-condition.)
173	
174	/-- Degree, weighted by residue degrees over the base field. -/
175	noncomputable def CurveDivisor.deg (K) (D : X.CurveDivisor) : ℤ :=
176	  D.sum fun x n => n * (residueDeg K x.1 : ℤ)
177	theorem deg_add : deg K (D + D') = deg K D + deg K D'      -- (E-ii) divisor half, free
178	theorem deg_single : deg K (single x n) = n * residueDeg K x.1
179	
180	/-- The principal divisor of a nonzero rational function. -/
181	noncomputable def divOf (f : X.functionFieldˣ) : X.CurveDivisor
182	  -- x ↦ ordUnits x f; finite support: f is the generic germ of a section s on a nonempty
183	  -- open U (stalk = colimit); ord = 0 on U ⊓ basicOpen s (mem_basicOpen germ-unit,
184	  -- Mathlib AlgebraicGeometry/Scheme.lean:658) and off it the locus is closed, avoids the
185	  -- generic point, hence finite (landed Scheme.finite_of_isClosed_of_notMem_genericPoint +
186	  -- the §1 Noetherian derivation); poles = zeros of f⁻¹, same argument.
187	theorem divOf_mul : divOf (f * g) = divOf f + divOf g       -- ordUnits is a hom
188	```

190	### 3.3 Interface to L2's `LocalEquations`/`picClass` — the binding coordination note
191	
192	The two lanes keep **one divisor notion each, with a pinned one-way bridge owned by this
193	lane**; no lane redefines the other's carrier.
194	
195	- L2's `Scheme.LocalEquations` (wave3 §2.6(a)) is the *Cartier-style datum* (cover + equations
196	  + regularity + unit ratios) used to build cocycle classes on arbitrary schemes.
197	- This lane's `CurveDivisor` is the *Weil-style ledger index* on the curve.
198	- Bridge (this lane, file R11): for `d : X.LocalEquations` on the curve,

200	```lean
201	noncomputable def LocalEquations.toDivisor (d : X.LocalEquations) : X.CurveDivisor
202	  -- x ↦ ord_x of the generic-germ ratio of d's equation at x (well-defined: the
203	  -- ratio_isUnit field makes the order independent of the chart index; finite support
204	  -- by the same closed-locus argument as divOf, using regularity)
205	theorem toDivisor_effective (hd : ∀ x, d is regular-section data) : 0 ≤ d.toDivisor

247	## 4. The sheaf ledger (task pins 1/4, cohomological substrate)

249	### 4.1 `𝒪(D)` as a subsheaf of the constant function-field sheaf (file R4)
250	
251	```lean
252	/-- The subsheaf of K(X) of rational functions with poles bounded by D. -/
253	noncomputable def Scheme.divisorSheaf (K) (D : X.CurveDivisor) :
254	    Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) (ModuleCat.{u} K)
255	  -- sections over U: {g : X.functionField | ∀ x ∈ U, x ≠ generic →
256	  --                      ord x g ≤ ofAdd (D x) in ℤᵐ⁰}   (g = 0 included: valuation 0 = ⊥)
257	  -- a K-submodule of K(X): K ⊆ 𝒪ˣ_x ∪ {0} (structure map through a local ring), and
258	  -- valuation bounds are closed under + and K-scaling. Restrictions: Submodule.inclusion.
259	  -- Sheaf condition: via isSheaf_iff_isSheaf_forget on the Type-level presheaf, as the
260	  -- landed isSheaf_moduleKPresheaf did (ModuleKSheaf.lean:247): on an irreducible space a
261	  -- compatible family of elements of K(X) indexed by a cover is a single element (any two
262	  -- nonempty opens meet), and the defining predicate is pointwise-local.
263	theorem divisorSheaf_mono (h : D ≤ D') : divisorSheaf K D ⟶ divisorSheaf K D'  -- Mono, sectionwise ⊆
264	```

266	*Sign convention*: `g ∈ 𝒪(D)(U) ⟺ ord_x(g) ≥ −D_x` on `U`, i.e. `L(D) := Γ(𝒪(D))` is
267	papaioannou Def 1.9 / cff §12 `L(A)` verbatim (both read). In the `ℤᵐ⁰` vocabulary the
268	condition reads `valuation g ≤ exp(D x)` — monotone-decreasing exp convention of

271	### 4.2 `𝒪(0) ≅ 𝒪` — the anchor iso (file R4)
272	
273	```lean
274	noncomputable def divisorSheafZeroIso : divisorSheaf K 0 ≅ X.moduleKSheaf K
275	```
276	
277	Sectionwise: `Γ(U, 𝒪_X) ≅ {g ∈ K(X) | ∀ x ∈ U closed, ord_x g ≥ 0}`. Injectivity is the
278	landed `germ_injective_of_isIntegral`; surjectivity is **sections = ⋂ of stalks inside the
279	function field**: an everywhere-regular `g` is locally a section (stalk = colimit), the local
280	sections agree on overlaps (they agree in `K(X)` and sections inject), and glue. Blueprint
281	node with complete proof; algebra anchor for the affine model: Stacks

8	# `ModuleCat k`-valued sheaf cohomology and the structure sheaf as a sheaf of modules
9	
10	This file provides the cohomology carrier for the genus lane of the Jacobian challenge:
11	
12	1. For a small site `(C, J)` and a commutative ring `R`, the degree-`n` cohomology
13	   `Sheaf.HModule F n` of a sheaf `F` of `R`-modules, defined as the `Ext`-group from the
14	   constant sheaf with value `R` to `F` (mirroring `CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H`, which is
15	   `AddCommGrpCat`-valued; ours is `ModuleCat R`-valued so that `Module.finrank` applies).
16	   Each `Sheaf.HModule F n` is an `R`-module via the `R`-linear structure of the sheaf
17	   category, and `Sheaf.HModule.map` gives `R`-linear functoriality in `F`.
18	2. The degree-zero identification `Sheaf.HModule.linearEquiv₀ : HModule F 0 ≃ₗ[R] F(⊤)`
19	   via `Ext⁰ ≅ Hom` and the constant-sheaf adjunction, together with its naturality.
20	3. For a scheme `X` over `Spec k`, the structure sheaf of `X` as a sheaf of `k`-modules
21	   `Scheme.moduleKSheaf` on the small Zariski site `Opens.grothendieckTopology X`, by
22	   restriction of scalars along the structure morphism, with definitional (`rfl`) access
23	   to its sections and restriction maps.

25	## Universe discipline
26	
27	Everything is single-universe: `k : Type u`, `X : Scheme.{u}`, the site `Opens X : Type u`
28	with hom-types in `Type u`, and coefficients `ModuleCat.{u} k`. Then
29	`Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) (ModuleCat.{u} k)` is Grothendieck abelian relative
30	to `u` (`ModuleCat.{u} k` is, and the site is small), hence `HasExt.{u}` holds and
31	`Sheaf.HModule F n : Type u` with a `Module k` structure — no universe bump anywhere, so
32	`Module.finrank k` applies directly downstream.

36	* `Sheaf.HModule` is an `abbrev` for `Abelian.Ext`, so the entire mathlib `Ext` API
37	  (long exact sequences `Ext.covariant_sequence_exact₁/₂/₃`, `Ext.extClass`, the
38	  Mayer–Vietoris machinery of `CategoryTheory/Sites/SheafCohomology`) applies
39	  transparently; we do not rebuild any of it.

25	(`Abelian.Ext.subsingleton_one_of_injective_of_surjective`, proved here for any abelian

194	        ((cokernel.π ι).hom.app (op (X.basicOpen f₀))).hom s =

13	# Skyscraper (pre)sheaves
14	
15	A skyscraper (pre)sheaf `𝓕 : (Pre)Sheaf C X` is the (pre)sheaf with value `A` at point `p₀` that is
16	supported only at open sets contain `p₀`, i.e. `𝓕(U) = A` if `p₀ ∈ U` and `𝓕(U) = *` if `p₀ ∉ U`
17	where `*` is a terminal object of `C`. In terms of stalks, `𝓕` is supported at all specializations
18	of `p₀`, i.e. if `p₀ ⤳ x` then `𝓕ₓ ≅ A` and if `¬ p₀ ⤳ x` then `𝓕ₓ ≅ *`.
19	
20	## Main definitions
21	
22	* `skyscraperPresheaf`: `skyscraperPresheaf p₀ A` is the skyscraper presheaf at point `p₀` with
23	  value `A`.
24	* `skyscraperSheaf`: the skyscraper presheaf satisfies the sheaf condition.
25	
26	## Main statements
27	
28	* `skyscraperPresheafStalkOfSpecializes`: if `y ∈ closure {p₀}` then the stalk of
29	  `skyscraperPresheaf p₀ A` at `y` is `A`.
30	* `skyscraperPresheafStalkOfNotSpecializes`: if `y ∉ closure {p₀}` then the stalk of
31	  `skyscraperPresheaf p₀ A` at `y` is `*` the terminal object.

55	/-- A skyscraper presheaf is a presheaf supported at a single point: if `p₀ ∈ X` is a specified
56	point, then the skyscraper presheaf `𝓕` with value `A` is defined by `U ↦ A` if `p₀ ∈ U` and
57	`U ↦ *` if `p₀ ∉ A` where `*` is some terminal object.
58	-/
59	@[simps]
60	def skyscraperPresheaf : Presheaf C X where
61	  obj U := if p₀ ∈ unop U then A else terminal C
62	  map {U V} i :=
63	    if h : p₀ ∈ unop V then eqToHom <| by rw [if_pos h, if_pos (by simpa using i.unop.le h)]
64	    else ((if_neg h).symm.ndrec terminalIsTerminal).from _
65	  map_id U :=
66	    (em (p₀ ∈ U.unop)).elim (fun h => dif_pos h) fun h =>
67	      ((if_neg h).symm.ndrec terminalIsTerminal).hom_ext _ _
68	  map_comp {U V W} iVU iWV := by
69	    by_cases hW : p₀ ∈ unop W
70	    · have hV : p₀ ∈ unop V := leOfHom iWV.unop hW
71	      simp only [dif_pos hW, dif_pos hV, eqToHom_trans]
72	    · dsimp; rw [dif_neg hW]; apply ((if_neg hW).symm.ndrec terminalIsTerminal).hom_ext
73	
74	theorem skyscraperPresheaf_eq_pushforward
75	    [hd : ∀ U : Opens (TopCat.of PUnit.{u + 1}), Decidable (PUnit.unit ∈ U)] :
76	    skyscraperPresheaf p₀ A =
77	      (ofHom (ContinuousMap.const (TopCat.of PUnit) p₀)) _*
78	        skyscraperPresheaf (X := TopCat.of PUnit) PUnit.unit A := by
79	  convert_to @skyscraperPresheaf X p₀ (fun U => hd <| (Opens.map <| ofHom <|
80	      ContinuousMap.const _ p₀).obj U)
81	    C _ _ A = _ <;> congr
